title: Delonix regia flower extract protects against diabetic cardiac remodeling via modulating eNOS/NO/cGMP and NF-kappaB/iNOS/TNF-alpha trajectories.
authors: Hassan, Nadia; Mohamed, Maged; Hassan, Noura A; Mohammed, Heba Osama; Abdelmoniem, Hadeer Omar; Al-Zayat, Khaled A; Chhajed, Shweta; Abdelkhalek, Ahmed S; Dufresne, Craig; El-Sadek, Mohamed E; Chen, Sixue; Mostafa, Islam; Arafa, Asmaa M
journal: The Journal of pharmacy and pharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究凤凰木花提取物对糖尿病心脏重构的保护作用，涉及信号通路和分子对接，但核心是植物药理学与心血管疾病，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to elucidate potential mechanisms associated with the cardioprotective efficacy of methanolic Delonix regia extract against the pathophysiological diabetic cardiac remodeling. METHODS: Phytochemical analysis of the D. regia extract was conducted utilizing liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry. Diabetes was induced using a high fructose/salt/fat diet, with a concurrent low dose streptozotocin. The extract was administered orally during the final six weeks. KEY FINDINGS: The analysis identified fifty-nine phytoconstituents within the floral extract. Functionally, the extract was associated with improvements in diabetes-induced alterations in cardiac performance and normalization of electrocardiographic indicators of ventricular activity. Structurally, the extract was associated with attenuation of cardiac remodeling, including reduced cardiomyocyte hypertrophy, improvement of diabetes-induced structural distortions, and decreased fibrotic deposition. Additionally, the extract was associated with modulation of apoptotic markers and increased levels of endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS), tetrahydrobiopterin, cyclic guanosine monophosphate, and glutathione. Molecular docking suggested that these effects may be attributable to the combined actions of phenolic and flavonoid constituents. CONCLUSIONS: Methanolic extract of D. regia may have therapeutic potential in the attenuating left ventricular remodeling associated with diabetic cardiomyopathy. These effects appear to be associated with modulation of eNOS/NO/cGMP and NF-kappaB/iNOS/TNF-alpha trajectories, along with anti-apoptotic and antifibrotic actions.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在阐明甲醇提取的凤凰木（Delonix regia）提取物对糖尿病心脏重塑病理生理过程中心脏保护功效的潜在机制。方法：利用液相色谱-串联质谱法对凤凰木提取物进行植物化学分析。采用高果糖/盐/脂肪饮食并同时给予低剂量链脲佐菌素诱导糖尿病。在最后六周内口服给予该提取物。主要发现：分析鉴定出花提取物中的五十九种植物成分。功能上，该提取物与糖尿病引起的心脏性能改变的改善及心室活动心电图指标的正常化相关。结构上，该提取物与心脏重塑的减轻相关，包括心肌细胞肥大的减少、糖尿病引起的结构畸形的改善以及纤维化沉积的减少。此外，该提取物与凋亡标志物的调节以及内皮型一氧化氮合酶（eNOS）、四氢生物蝶呤、环磷酸鸟苷和谷胱甘肽水平的升高相关。分子对接提示这些效应可能归因于酚类和黄酮类成分的联合作用。结论：凤凰木甲醇提取物在减轻与糖尿病心肌病相关的左心室重塑方面可能具有治疗潜力。这些效应似乎与eNOS/NO/cGMP和NF-kappaB/iNOS/TNF-alpha通路的调节以及抗凋亡和抗纤维化作用相关。
